ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF MAY 13, 2014 (as revised), SEPTEMBER 23, 2014 AND OCTOBER 7, 2014
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council meetings of May 13, 2014 (as revised), September 23, 2014 and October 7, 2014.
A- 1 Minutes
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - NONE
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
REPORT AND DISCUSSION REGARDING THE STATUS OF MUNICIPAL GRANTS
It is recommended that the City Council review and file this report regarding the status of municipal grants.
C-1 Status of Municipal Grants
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1373 AND 26
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 14-5166 approving Warrant Register No. 1373 and Resolution No. SA 14-42 approving Warrant Register No. 26.
D-1 Warrrant Register No. 1373
D-1 Warrant Register No. 26
D-2
AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND FELIPE FREGOSO FOR THE VOLUNTARY SURRENDER OF UNCLASSIFIED USE PERMIT NO. 137 - 16161 E. OLD VALLEY BOULEVARD - LAS MARIPOSAS RESTAURANT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Agreement for the Voluntary Surrender of Unclassified Use Permit No. 137 between the City of La Puente and Felipe Fregoso.
D-2 Surrender of Use Permit
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER FOR THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY'S RELAY FOR LIFE OF LA PUENTE EVENT
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached resolution approving a request for a fee waiver in the amount of $4290.00, for the American Cancer Society California Division Inc. 2015 Relay for Life of La Puente event.
D- 3 Relay for Life
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A PARTNER AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND VISION SERVICE PLAN ("VSP") FOR THE MOBILE EYES PROGRAM
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Partner Agreement with Vision Service Plan for the Mobile Eyes Program.
D-4 Mobile Eyes Program
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A REQUEST FROM THE CALIFORNIA REDEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATION TO AMEND THE CORPORATE BYLAWS AND ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION TO ELIMINATE MEMBERSHIP
Staff recommends that the Agency Board approve the amendment to the CRA's bylaws and articles of incorporation to eliminate membership.
D-5 CRA
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AND PURCHASE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND BLUE VIOLET NETWORKS, LLC FOR TELECOMMUNICATIONS SYSTEM EQUIPMENT AND SERVICES IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $74,341.11
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Professional Services Agreement and purchase agreement with Blue Violet Networks, LLC for telecommunications system equipment and services.
D-6 Telecommunication System
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING FINDINGS TO DISPENSE WITH THE COMPETITIVE BIDDING PROCESS AND APPROVING A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT, INC. FOR TRAFFIC DETOUR AND CONTROL SERVICES FOR CITY SPECIAL EVENTS IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $60,000
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached Resolution making findings to dispense with the competitive bidding process and approve a Professional Services Agreement with Traffic Management, Inc. for traffic detour and control services for City special events.
E-1 Traffic Services
E-2
DISCUSSION REGARDING CODE ENFORCEMENT (COUNCIL MEMBER KLINAKIS)
Council discussion and direction.
E- 2 Code Enforcement

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this this 9th day of October, 2014
